name: Business Travel Checklist
description: A complete business travel checklist covering documents, work tech, professional attire, expenses and pre-trip tasks.

items.text: ID or passport and any required visas
Flight, hotel, and transport confirmations
Printed and digital copies of your itinerary
Meeting agenda and contact details
Business cards
Company travel policy and approval documents
Laptop and charger
Phone, charging cable, and a power bank
Universal travel adapter for international trips
items.note: Check the plug type and voltage for your destination.

items.text: Noise-canceling headphones
Presentation clicker, dongles, and adapters
External drive or notebook for backups
Spare pens and a slim folder for documents
Outfits for each meeting day plus one spare
Wrinkle-resistant suit, blazer, or dress
Dress shirts or blouses
Dress shoes and matching belt
Accessories: tie, scarf, or jewelry
A garment bag to keep attire crisp
Comfortable travel-day outfit
Casual evening wear for dinners
Workout clothes and shoes if you use the gym
Sleepwear
Underwear and socks for the trip plus spares
Travel-sized toiletries within carry-on limits
Toothbrush, toothpaste, and deodorant
Daily medications and a small first-aid kit
Razor and grooming kit
Hand sanitizer and a face mask
Corporate or personal card and some cash
Envelope or app to collect receipts
Per diem details and expense policy
Local currency for international trips
Note of reimbursable categories and limits
Set an out-of-office reply and delegate tasks
Confirm meeting times across time zones
Charge all devices fully
Download files, slides, and offline maps
Check in for your flight and save boarding passes
Arrange airport transport at both ends

faq.q: What should I pack for a business trip?
faq.a: Pack professional attire suited to your meetings, a laptop and chargers, travel documents, toiletries, and expense materials. Aim for a carry-on with wrinkle-resistant clothes so you avoid checked bags and arrive ready to work.

faq.q: How do I pack a suit without wrinkles?
faq.a: Roll or fold your suit in a garment bag or around tissue paper, pack it on top, and hang it as soon as you arrive. Choose wrinkle-resistant fabrics, and a quick steam in a hot shower bathroom can release any remaining creases.

faq.q: What tech should I bring for business travel?
faq.a: Bring your laptop, phone, all charging cables, a power bank, and a universal adapter for international trips. Add noise-canceling headphones, a presentation clicker or adapter if you are presenting, and any hardware your work requires.

faq.q: Can I print this business travel checklist?
faq.a: Yes. You can print the checklist or download it as a PDF, then tick off each item as you pack and prepare for your work trip.

faq.q: How do I track expenses while traveling for work?
faq.a: Keep all receipts in one envelope or photograph them with an expense app as you go, and note the date, purpose, and amount. Review your company's travel policy beforehand and log expenses daily so nothing is missed when you file.
